title: Fragment screening using biolayer interferometry reveals ligands targeting the SHP-motif binding site of the AAA+ ATPase p97
authors: Sebastian Bothe; Petra Hänzelmann; Stephan Böhler; Josef Kehrein; Christoph Wiedemann; Ute A. Hellmich; Ruth Brenk; Hermann Schindelin; Christoph Sotriffer
one_liner_zh: 该文用生物层干涉和分子动力学模拟筛选靶向p97蛋白SHP基序结合位点的小分子片段，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作与MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制研究关联较弱。
abstract: Biosensor techniques have become increasingly important for fragment-based drug discovery during the last years. Here, we describe a biolayer interferometry-based fragment screen targeting the AAA+ ATPase p97, an essential protein with key roles in protein homeostasis and a possible target for cancer chemotherapy. Currently available p97 inhibitors target its ATPase activity and globally impair p97-mediated processes. In contrast, inhibition of cofactor binding to the N-domain by a protein-protein-interaction inhibitor would enable the selective targeting of specific p97 functions. We demonstrate that a region known as SHP-motif binding site can be targeted with small molecules. Guided by molecular dynamics simulations, the binding sites of selected screening hits were postulated and experimentally validated using protein- and ligand-based NMR techniques, as well as X-ray crystallography, ultimately resulting in the first structure of a small molecule in complex with the N-domain of p97. The identified fragments provide insights into how this region could be targeted and present first chemical starting points for the development of a protein-protein interaction inhibitor preventing the binding of selected cofactors to p97.
abstract_zh: 近年来，生物传感器技术在基于片段的药物发现中变得越来越重要。在此，我们描述了一种基于生物层干涉法的片段筛选，针对AAA+ ATP酶p97，这是一种在蛋白质稳态中发挥关键作用且可能成为癌症化疗靶点的重要蛋白质。目前可用的p97抑制剂靶向其ATP酶活性，并全面损害p97介导的过程。相比之下，通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用抑制剂抑制辅因子与N-结构域的结合，将能够选择性靶向特定的p97功能。我们证明，一个称为SHP-基序结合位点的区域可以被小分子靶向。在分子动力学模拟的指导下，我们推测了选定筛选命中物的结合位点，并通过基于蛋白质和配体的核磁共振技术以及X射线晶体学进行了实验验证，最终获得了第一个小分子与p97 N-结构域复合物的结构。所识别的片段提供了关于如何靶向该区域的见解，并为开发阻止特定辅因子与p97结合的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用抑制剂提供了初步的化学起点。
